## Summary of Changes
Provide a brief description of what this PR accomplishes and why it is needed.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Performance improvement

## Architectural & Security Invariants Checklist
- [ ] **Zero-PII Compliance**: No personal data (names, emails, phones, raw IPs) is stored or logged.
- [ ] **Offline / Zero CDN**: No new external CDN dependencies or remote tracker scripts.
- [ ] **Test Coverage**: All existing pytest suites pass locally (`pytest tests/`).
- [ ] **New Tests Added**: Added test cases for new endpoints or business logic.
- [ ] **Code Hygiene**: Code adheres to Python 3.12+ type annotations and MD3 conventions.
